description: This Java class defines the configuration for entity aggregation calculated fields, including validation logic for arguments, metrics, and interval settings within a data processing framework.

classes.name: EntityAggregationCalculatedFieldConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for entity aggregation calculated fields, including validation logic and properties for arguments, metrics, interval, watermark, and output.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of calculated field, specifically ENTITY_AGGREGATION.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of arguments, metrics, and interval configurations.

methods.name: validateArguments
methods.description: Validates that reserved argument names are not used and only TS_LATEST argument types are present.

methods.name: validateMetrics
methods.description: Ensures metrics are not empty and reference known arguments.

methods.name: validateInterval
methods.description: Checks that the interval is defined and valid.
